replay.compare: mixdog-core-session src/session/k1_grants_replay.rs: one interpreter for the recorded logs; every step is done on the core and compared whole in recorded order: a decide's verdict written as Node's { decision, request, gate, remembered }, a choose's answered response, the grants and audit rows, the permission rows. Card fields (presented, normalized, fields, offered, grantActions) are the card a client is shown (room_approval tool_approval / normalize_tool_approval_request), taken at the keys humanRequestFields defines (the card also carries the queue's own name/args/cwd/reason fields); a response is the decision the approval book takes from a client's result (ApprovalBook::validate).
replay.entry: decide: the call runs through the product's pipeline mixdog_tools::policy::ToolPolicy::authorize as a turn runs it (the recorded hook as its PreToolUse hook; the facts and settings of mixdog_core_ports SessionGate over a live header per session, unattended runs and Allow all actions behind its GateEnv, the recorder's roster mailer/scribe as contact bots; the registered github tool and connector tools for outbound kinds; the session's grants in SessionGrantRegistry) until it shows the client a card or ends. The card is inserted into the client's mixdog_core_base ApprovalBook with the pipeline waiting on it. The verdict the pipeline acted on is read through the development-only feature policy-observer (ToolPolicy::with_observer, refused in release by build.rs) and written as Node's { decision, request, gate, remembered }; for a call the pipeline let run the decision is rendered from the call it passed on (Authorized: allow, or modify with the name/args it runs), the hook's reason being the hook's. The pipeline's outcome is checked against the verdict (a denied call errs, a call let run is Ok). choose/answer: the client's response as recorded, the recorded gate included as a field of the response, goes through ApprovalBook::validate on the card the client was shown and is resolved into the waiting pipeline, which audits it and stores its grant; the answered call runs exactly when approved. No core entry takes a gate from outside: the forged gates of hook-ask 6, 8 and session-grants 5, 6 reach the core inside the client's response and the core takes from it only the decision; the observables after it (grants, audit, later decides) are compared. A card no longer pending (a second answer to one gate, hook-ask 9 / session-grants 9) is the same call asked again and answered; an answer with no card to reach (an unattended run answers its own call) is sent to the last card and is a no-op. A timedOut answer resolves the card TimedOut, as the request's deadline resolves it (a client cannot send a timeout). An unanswered card is resolved interrupted when the log moves on, its call unrun. Store: FileGrantStore on a temp directory stamped with the recording's held Date.now; AgentPermissions (mixdog-core-agents) for agentPermissions/setAgentPermission. The session-grant clock starts at the recorder's 1_000_000 ms and moves only by the recorded advances; a reset is a clear (header compaction.lastClearAt), an ended life a closed header. Every wait and store call has a 30 s deadline with a message.

exclusions.session-grants case 4 field unknown: sessionLifeMark of a session id the store does not hold: the core builds a session's gate (SessionGate over the live header) only for a session it holds, so no life is read for an unknown id; the field is not compared
